purpose: Share flow execution across distinct data inputs using parametric summaries, balanced structural control and whole-caller bindings. One canonical solver; control and recurrence inputs remain specialized.

originalControlOracle.oracle: Every first PERFORM is unconditional and precedes the CALL; no branch exits before it.

remainingLimits: Combinatorial growth of specialized control/recurrence signatures, handlers and facts remains possible.
Candidate products, input bindings and expression instantiation retain their own cost.
No full historical suite, expanded scale30 or 117k LOC rerun; no universal performance guarantee.
Original baseline runs stop explicitly at max-work20000, not full completed analyses or repeated OOM attempts.
JFR allocation weights are sampled estimates, not exact allocation or live-memory totals.
